thread:
maria.support: Heads-up — Vanguard Systems says the PO credit we issued for PO-99321 (sales-approved $25,000) did not get applied to their latest invoice. Customer is upset; they called support. Invoice INV-2026 shows full amount charged. Can someone pick this up?

alex.cs: Sorry about that — tagging finance. Do we have the original PO note or the internal note that sales attached? Also can you paste the invoice link and customer account id?

maria.support: Invoice: https://billing.redwood.internal/invoices/INV-2026 Account: acct_9X2V. Raj from sales added a contract note: "Q3 ENTERPRISE PROMO - PO-99321 - apply credit 25k" on 2026-09-14. I can forward the email from the AE.

raj.sales: Confirmed — I created the PO and requested the credit on Sep 14. I added a PO note and told finance via email (thread: sales/PO-99321). I see the sales ledger shows a pending credit entry, but maybe it never propagated to billing. @olivia.finance any idea why propagation failed?

olivia.finance: I'm looking. Quick check: our reconciler logs show an error when trying to map PO-99321 to account acct_9X2V. It flagged "no active contract match" at 2026-09-15 03:12 UTC. That suggests the contract version on the account differs from the PO meta. I'll try a manual apply.

sam.engineer: If you want to repro locally, billing-reconciler has a command: 
```
./billing-reconciler --replay --po PO-99321 --env prod --dry-run
```
When I ran a dry-run earlier it returned: `reconciler: skip apply - contract_version mismatch (expected v4, found v3)`. Could be the account was not upgraded to the contract that maps to the promo rules.

olivia.finance: Thanks Sam. I'll escalate to Tyler for approval to do a manual credit entry and then reissue the invoice. Drafting ledger entry now.

tyler.finance: OK to proceed with manual adjustment. Please include a PO note referencing sales ticket and approval. Use internal ticket TKT-2345 for audit trail.

olivia.finance: Applying manual adjustment now. Command I used: 
```
billing-cli apply-credit --account acct_9X2V --po PO-99321 --amount 25000 --currency USD --note "Manual apply per sales request; TKT-2345; Raj" --approved-by tyler.finance
```
I got back: `200 OK - credit applied (adj_id ADJ-7789)`. Creating reissued invoice.

billing-bot: [auto] Ledger update recorded: ADJ-7789 for acct_9X2V. Related ticket: TKT-2345. Invoice INV-2026 replaced by INV-2026-R1.

maria.support: Customer updated — they can see the credit but asked why it happened in the first place and wants the PO note on file. Also they requested a 7-day service credit for the trouble. Can we approve?

raj.sales: I'll add the PO note to the contract and attach the sales email to the account. Also I'll open a JIRA to prevent this mismatch: BIL-789 (sales/finance sync). For the 7-day service credit, I can approve as a one-off under the enterprise goodwill policy.

olivia.finance: Service credit is non-billable; will create separate ADJ for account: 
```
billing-cli apply-credit --account acct_9X2V --amount 0 --service-credit-days 7 --note "Goodwill: 7 days service credit for invoicing delay - Raj" --approved-by raj.sales
```
Marked as service credit in reports.

sam.engineer: For follow-up, I'm adding a guard in the reconciler so it emits a clearer alert when contract_version mismatch occurs: https://engineering.redwood.internal/notes/reconciler-contract-guard. Will add unit test and staging deploy.

maria.support: Thanks all. Customer confirmed invoice adjustment and service credit visibility. They appreciated the quick turnaround. I've updated the support ticket with final notes and forwarded the AE email to finance. Closing the escalation once JIRA BIL-789 is created.

raj.sales: Created BIL-789 and linked email thread + PO. Will coordinate with prod infra to watch next reconciler run.

olivia.finance: Final: ADJ-7789 applied, INV-2026-R1 issued, service credit logged ADJ-7790, audit ticket TKT-2345 closed. Follow-up action: improve reconciler alerts and ensure sales PO note mapping step is covered in onboarding checklist.

maria.support: Marking resolved on our side. Closing thread. :white_check_mark:
